description: Communes en zones AMII du déploiement de la fibre optique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Mégalis Bretagne. Communes en zones AMII déployées directement par Orange ou SFR. Elles ne font pas partie du Projet BTHD, géré par Mégalis Bretagne. Coverage: Mégalis Bretagne. The publisher named on the listing is Mégalis Bretagne. Its keywords include donnees-ouvertes, ftth, reseaux-dinitiative-publique, fibre, zamii, inspire. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
